freshness.comparison: one commit ahead; only tools/materialize_agent_wiring.py changed

finding_1.name: V12 pre-provider persistence check can become stale during get cleanup
finding_1.source_reason: V12 checks require_persistence_ready() before ConversationSegmentStore.get(). The exact store get() runs cleanup, and cleanup may attempt an NCM28 write. A cleanup write failure can set persistence_blocked after the precheck but before provider invocation. Without a second readiness check, the provider can still be called while durable publication is already blocked.
finding_1.required_fix: After conversation_segments.get(conversation_key), re-check require_persistence_ready() before any provider planning. Fail 503 before provider if get/cleanup blocked persistence.

finding_2.name: Responses compaction still publishes ephemeral state before durable post-compaction state
finding_2.source_reason: handle_openai_compaction currently writes TurnAffinity first and then calls ConversationSegmentStore.put() using legacy non-strict semantics. ConversationSegmentStore swallows NCM28 write failures by setting persistence_blocked, so Codex can receive a compaction result while the durable awaiting_compacted_history transition was never published.
finding_2.risk: After restart the bridge may continue the pre-compaction Notion segment even though Codex already accepted a compacted context, creating a lifecycle mismatch.
finding_2.required_fix: With V12 store API applied, strictly publish the compaction segment first (require_persistence when conversation identity exists), then update TurnAffinity, then return compact_payload. Surface ConversationPersistenceError as 503 before client publication.
